mapper.select: SELECT FROM questions q INNER JOIN users u ON q.UID = u.UID INNER JOIN chapters ch ON q.CHID = ch.CHID INNER JOIN courses c ON ch.CUID = c.CUID WHERE q.QID = #{qid}
